groups.name: Youth Ministry
groups.description: Students volunteer every other month at a variety of locations around our community. Some regular places we serve are: FISH Walton County, Pregnancy Resource Center, Uniting Hope 4 Children, Clarkston Refugee Missions.

groups.name: Acolyte Ministry
groups.description: Acolytes are a vital part of our worship service, and a large number of our students serve as acolytes.
